notes.title: Hamsterdam Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]IT'S HAMSTER TIME[/h1]
It’s August 1st and you know what that means
HAMSTERDAM IS RELEASING TODAY

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/fab88b26fb5269c511fa31cca053889ac4328558.png[/img]

[h1]RELEASE DAY STREAM[/h1]
Celebrate release day with us as we stream for our entire office day:
[b]10 AM - 6 PM EDT[/b]
You can watch on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/musegamesnyc]Twitch![/url]

Meet our Art Team, talk to IRL Hamster-Fu Master Derek, and watch us play Hamsterdam.
We’ll be hanging out on the Hamsterdam Discord, so hop in and join!
[i]PS. Surprise giveaways![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/730dd35ea0abff368563641acf0dbd9b04880b37.png[/img]

[h1]PLUSHIE FLASH SALE[/h1]
You have been eyeing our adorable Pimm Plushies, and for Release Day you can get them for $20 and free world-wide shipping!
[url=https://muse-games.square.site/product/hamsterdam-pimm-plushie-/10?cp=true&sbp=false]Go to Shop[/url]

[h1]THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH[/h1]
Releasing Hamsterdam has been a long dream of ours, and we couldn’t have made it without each and every one of you. Your trust in our vision is something we deeply value, and we hope you enjoy playing this game as much as we have enjoyed creating it - and if you do, please show your support by leaving us a review.

Now go become the Hamster-Fu master you were always meant to be and go kick Marlo’s butt!

notes.title: Hamsterdam Steam Demo available now!
notes.content:
[h1]HOW TO GET THE DEMO[/h1]
Click the “Download Demo” button on the right side of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/922040/Hamsterdam/]Hamsterdam Steam page![/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/834e6f704f7299f762dcdd26b650d2a21fd32514.png[/img]
[img][/img]
[h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/922040/discussions/0/1837937637888137570/]WHAT’S INCLUDED[/url][/h1]
This demo includes ‘Canal’ - the first of the 3 Districts in Hamsterdam - with 10 levels, 2 bonus scooter levels, and 2 boss confrontations. You vs. Marlo and his gang of vermin: Can you beat them all and complete the demo?

[h1]HELP THE DEVS: BECOME A TEST HAMSTER[/h1]
After you've played the demo, help us and fill out a quick Feedback Survey to get a chance to win a Pimm Plushie of your own! 

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfEatEbLXPn00lA3k_AN7NZY2mXdULeF8BUn22cQC47oi122g/viewform?usp=sf_link][b]Click here to take the survey![/b][/url]

[b][IMPORTANT][/b] Check out the Testing Menu in Settings to log your time: 
This data will be used to pace the levels and difficulties, and helps us a ton! We appreciate every entry.

[h1]WISHLIST HAMSTERDAM[/h1]
Wishlisting is an important part of supporting the games you love.
Show Steam and the algorithm that you support Hamsterdam and help us get featured!
Clicking that ‘Add to your wishlist’ button can make all the difference.

[h1][url=discord.gg/GRWzhZp]HAMSTERDAM DISCORD[/url][/h1]
Join the Hamster Squad! We have an amazing community we talk to daily AND OTHER FUN STUFF:

[list][*][b]TRIVIA[/b]
Answer trivia, rank up in Hamster-fu, and get cool prizes! Prizes include stuff like Hamster Plushies, Name in Credits, exclusive in-game cosmetics, and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/c4bc5deeabc19d52ca903124d2f176558b9b1e12.png[/img]

[*][b]THE WEEKLY WHEEL[/b]
Hamsterdam’s official newspaper posted on here & Discord. Contribute to the lore, say silly stuff in chat! We love puns :D

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/aa9783093df74b511d02334304cea9e70922fc01.png[/img]

[*][b]MEMES & FEEDBACK[/b]
Share your experiences with us, and let us learn from you. Hamsterdam Discord is a place for everything from fun hangouts and edgy hamster memes, to game testing and feedback submissions. We really value your input and try to be extra attentive over there!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/954b59f93f2348d69d4c13e38f9bcaad43745962.png[/img][/list]

[h1]Follow Hamsterdam on social media:[/h1]
[url=facebook.com/hamsterdamgame]Facebook[/url] | [url=twitter.com/hamsterdamgame]Twitter[/url] | [url=instagram.com/hamsterdamgame]Instagram[/url]

notes.title: Hamsterdam Nominated for IMGA!
notes.content:
The International Mobile Gaming Awards is one of the longest standing award that honours 'outstanding games' made for mobile devices, and we've now been nominated for a second year!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/c8c46600270ea12749ba4a91ac134b384d1e2354.png[/img]

The award is met by the community voting on our behalf, and so we most humbly would ask you to help us bring this home:
[list][*]You can vote for us by [url=https://www.imgawards.com/games/hamsterdam-2/]clicking here![/url]
[*]Like & RT & Share our posts on [url=https://twitter.com/hamsterdamgame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/hamsterdamgame/]Facebook[/url] and [url=instagram.com/hamsterdamgame]Instagram[/url]
[*]Comment on the posts and tell us how you first came to encounter Hamsterdam[/list]
Thank you all so much. With your help we've already been nominated, and received so many honours for our game, and it's not even out yet! This is in large part thanks to the amazing people this game attracts. We've always been blessed with supportive communities around our games, and we couldn't be prouder to release this game with all your help, love, and support.

Happy Weekend!

notes.title: Plushies, Awards, & Progress
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

[h1]Plushies Update[/h1]

Before I get into development updates, which there are quite a few, I must first update everyone on the most important and burning question - Where are the plushies for Kickstarter Backers!? 

They are being boxed and shipped!  And we should get them in about 2 weeks.

These Plushies will also be available at our booth at Pax East!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/aed71891352acfac5e05ea9b059d8c82c20ade92.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hamsterdam Establishments[/h1]

4 new establishments - Let's Taco About It, Bubbles Pet Shop, Maison Misiao, and Ham-Bao Cafe - opened in Hamsterdam this week, thanks to our generous Citizenship tier Kickstarter backers. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/39bbe2be9174a9a55b667073b33ba8e0d70478c7.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/e9326935374b103ae21c4fa61d4b7b24bc45bd27.png[/img]

We're now working on some backer look alike citizens! Thanks again everyone!

[h1]In the News[/h1]

Pimm's been nominated in 2 more awards! 

Best Style and Mobile Game of the Year at the [url=https://www.thebitawards.com/awards]Bit Awards[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/b00ebbc3d2060c434bac667ef30640c5d499bcd5.png[/img]

Best Design and Best Mobile Game at the [url=http://tgs.tca.org.tw/indie_award_finalist.php?b=2b_c]Taipei Game Show Indie Game Award[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/2c15ee214d464be6b7fff18cc41126e3ed9be22f.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/9bace8b188d38a47f4ff650595ad522e5d88cd8a.png[/img]

Additionally, we'll be showing Hamster-fu on both the Nintendo Switch and tablets at Pax East!  

If you're at Pax, you'll get to do what Cameron is doing :D

https://youtu.be/qbtnECf6CCo

We're super proud and excited, and wanted to share the news with everyone! 

[h1]Development Progress:[/h1]

We've been spending quite a bit of time tuning all the bosses, and they are in pretty good fighting shape! Thanks to everyone who've given valuable feedback so far!  

Here are some play-throughs for your entertainment:  

[b]Canal District Marlo: [/b]
https://youtu.be/ZhD84ry-XFE
[b]Red Light District Mini Boss: [/b]
https://youtu.be/4zrKkjbMbuA
[b]Marlo Mansion Mini Boss (AKA The Battle Up the Elevator Shaft)[/b]
https://youtu.be/tZGrN5SnwI4
The controller inputs are in good shape as well. With some additions of tutorial icons and menu navigation support, we'll have full controller support on PC, and we can start sending out demo builds for people to test and try! 

The final boss is being tuned this week, and it's coming along nicely. We definitely want to make this battle more challenging :D Because it is the end, and it should be more epic! 

With the graphical power of latest gen mobile devices and the Switch, we were able take advantage and do more graphical polish, and here are some results.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/f8b9a58881edfc93b3f6a63148c82acf1ed66cc4.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/65eaf58c176a6dbb2b55e66cedbac13375c12d57.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33786022/1e2e91b09b3240ae3d5439f327febb5f19d9c6ee.png[/img]

The achievement, game stats, and move library (Hamster-fu Chronicles) systems are also completed and in the latest development build. We're working on some achievement icons and in game tutorial videos for the move library. 

On the docket for the next couple of weeks are: 
[list]
[*] Polishing up the final boss 
[*] Tuning the Joy-Con controls in boss levels
[*] Complete the iconography and move videos for the move library
[*] Finalize all the in game text for translations
[*] Add an immersive tutorialization for QTEs and Joy-Con orientation
[*] Full controller & Joy-Con support
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/GRWzhZp]If you haven't joined our Discord yet, come on over![/url] We're talking about Hamster tourism and popular services & establishments such as Hamazon, 5 Mice, and Scuttlewheel Fitness. We're also prepping for regular Hamsterdam, Hamster-fu, and hamsters trivia. If you move up in Hamster-fu rank, you'll be soon earning prizes!  [url=https://discord.gg/GRWzhZp]So now is the perfect time to join! [/url]

Thanks again! 

Team Muse
